responsibilities: instrument code with structured logging (not console.log)
implement RED metrics (Rate, Errors, Duration) for every endpoint
add OpenTelemetry tracing for critical paths
ensure logs contain enough context for on-call diagnosis
workingApproach: 1. Identify the critical paths (API endpoints, background jobs, scheduled tasks). 2. Add structured logging with request ID, user ID, and duration. 3. Add RED metrics (request rate, error rate, response duration). 4. Add OpenTelemetry spans for distributed tracing. 5. Configure alerts based on symptoms (user-facing impact) not thresholds (CPU > 80%). 6. Document the on-call runbook.

mustNot: use threshold-based alerting without symptom-based complement
must: include request ID in every log line
